description: This Java source file defines the 'Module' class, which models a module derived from a makefile within an Android build environment. It handles parsing makefiles, managing dependencies, source files, and generating IDE project files (.iml).

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a build module constructed from a makefile, providing methods to parse dependencies, source files, and generate IDE artifacts.

methods.name: Module
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Module object based on the module directory, optionally parsing source files.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Performs parsing of the makefile, builds dependency lists, and prepares dependent modules.

methods.name: getDir
methods.description: Returns the directory of the module.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module (the directory name).

methods.name: buildImlFile
methods.description: Generates and writes the IntelliJ IDEA module file (.iml) based on current module data.

methods.name: buildIntermediates
methods.description: Constructs XML snippet for intermediate build output directories for the IDE.

methods.name: buildDependentModules
methods.description: Identifies and caches dependencies of the module, updating dependency sets accordingly.

methods.name: getImlFile
methods.description: Returns the generated .iml file for the module.

methods.name: getAllDependencies
methods.description: Returns the set of all dependencies (direct and indirect) of this module.

methods.name: getAllDependentImlFiles
methods.description: Returns the set of all dependent modules' .iml files.

methods.name: buildAndroidFacet
methods.description: Creates XML configuration snippet for Android-specific facets in the IDE.
